{"id": "353ac527-ceed-4ab2-b4e1-36711ed08b96", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "For CloudFront data transfer out to the internet from edge locations in **Europe, Israel, and Türkiye**, the pay-as-you-go pricing tiers (per GB) are:

| Usage Tier (per month) | Price |
|---|---|
| First 1 TB | Free |
| Next 9 TB | $0.085/GB |
| Next 40 TB | $0.080/GB |
| Next 100 TB | $0.060/GB |

So after the free tier, you'd pay $0.085 per GB until you cross 10TB/month, then the rate steps down as volume increases. Let me know if you want the rates for other regions or a cost estimate for a specific traffic volume.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
